notes.title: BIG UPDATE - FLAME OF MEMORY
notes.notes:
New features:
- new GUI style
- clear system  of hints, just one click when you do not know what you should do now
- experience system
- skills tree
- bug fixes
- new soundtrack and sounds
- and more!
